record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: Reachable frontier changed from creating a reusable consumer court to scaling independent consumer adoption. Canonical R48 court is merged upstream; cloud has one independently contained consumer; ggen PR #668 now consumes the same canonical court and its owning exact-head court is ALIVE. Newly reachable edges after broad-CI closure: merge ggen; prove default containment; enumerate repositories whose exact subjects are explicitly admitted by producer fixture; manufacture target-local identity/workflow adapters only for admitted targets; then measure downstream qualified actions caused by each consumer. Writable repository census is broad but does not itself prove compatibility, so unknown repos remain candidates rather than consumers.

next_edges: merge ggen after broad CI ALIVE
